fields.Name: T173 - Filter Certifications by Status
fields.Description: Verifies that the grid quick-filter on the Certifications grid responds to a status term by narrowing the visible rows (or showing a clear no-match state).

InputDefinition.goal: To open the 'Certifications' entity, use the LEFT sidebar 'Search entities...' box - type 'Certifications' and click the node named EXACTLY 'Certifications' (NOT 'Certification Types' or 'Certificates'). Do NOT fight a group expand-chevron. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment - wait, don't navigate away. Once the Certifications grid is loaded, type a status term such as 'Active' into the grid's quick-filter box ('Filter records...'). NOTE: this quick-filter is CLIENT-SIDE over the rows already loaded on the current page, so do NOT expect it to find a specific off-page record. Success is reached when the grid visibly RESPONDS to the filter - the displayed rows narrow to those matching 'Active', OR the grid shows a clear no-match / empty state for that term.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Certifications entity grid is open in the Data Explorer Data section
A status term (e.g. 'Active') has been entered into the grid's quick-filter ('Filter records...') box
The grid visibly responds to the filter: the displayed rows narrow to matches OR a clear no-match/empty state is shown for that term
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
